entry.title: Wikipelago v1.0.0
entry.content:
## Wikipelago 1.0.0
A custom Archipelago world inspired by wiki racing. Each check is a **Start → Target** round: click Wikipedia links to reach the target, collect items, and finish the **Grand Goal**.
Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7**. Web client: https://wikipelago.dreskn.fr/
Install `wikipelago.apworld` and this YAML from the assets below, then generate a **new** seed.
### How it plays - Only in-article Wikipedia links count as moves - Some rounds are open at the start; **Round Access** unlocks more - Collect **Knowledge Fragments** to reveal the Grand Goal, a question with the answer being your final goal page. Reach it to finish the slot.
### Languages Play on **English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, or Polish** Wikipedia (`wikipedia_language` in the YAML). The top-right dropdown only translates the client UI; it does not change which wiki you race on.
### Defaults and extras - **Side branches** can be unlocked by reaching a crossroad and obtaining a key. They are themed target pages that you can reach simultaneously as progressing the main road. - **Letter-pair bingo** adds boards filled with letter pais. Visit pages starting with these paris to stamp your board. Full lines count as location checks. Stamps can be found to check a nasty letter pair! - Tools: **Back**, **Reroll**, **Search**, **Compass** can help you navigate the game, can be unlocked from the start or through the pool. - Optional spice (off by default): deaths and deathlink, traps and traplink, sanities, hiding parts of wiki pages, Use at your own risk.
### Docs [Overview](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/overview.md) · [Setup](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/setup.md) · [Options](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/options.md) · [FAQ](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/faq.md)
### Older rooms The hosted client is 1.0 after this release. Old seeds should continue to work on the new client, but to stay on the old 0.6 client, run locally from tag [`0.6.0-ZaWarudo!`](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/releases/tag/v0.6.0-ZaWarudo!), see [Setup, Option 2](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/blob/main/docs/setup.md#option-2--local-client-private--vpn-rooms).

entry.title: Divinity Original Sin 2 v0.9.0
entry.content:
New: - The journal now contains quests that match every non-containersanity check. These are split into two categories in the journal, "Archipelago Quests" and "Archipelago Kills", which have all the checks that match their namesake. These quests will be completed upon sending the check they represent and will persist through saves, so they will always be accurate to what you have and have not sent yet. - There is a known bug where completing a quest will have it not be removed from the active part of the journal and its archive will have no description. Changes/Bugfixes: - The quest Invaders has been removed, as killing the Sallow Man doesn't send the check properly. - Saeva the Many-faced, Sahun Woundbinder, Urrha the Snake Charmer, and Kajun Frozenheart (Karon's ads) have been removed as they send their check preemptively since they technically die when Arx initializes. - You can no longer receive items in the character creator and lose them. - Loading a new game or other playthrough that is not the Archipelago one will now sync your items immediately instead of after getting a check. Should be smoother if you have to start a new game mid Archipelago. - The about page in the GitHub has been updated.

entry.title: One Must Fall: 2097 v0.0.5
entry.content:
# Archipelago OpenOMF v0.0.5
> OMF:2097 was released as freeware by Epic MegaGames in 1999. The game data is freely and legally downloadable.
---
### What's New
#### Fixes (Multiworld)
- Fixed shop purchases not being remembered when the location's item belongs to another game in the multiworld. Shop state was previously rebuilt from `ReceivedItems`, which only fires for items sent back to *us* — a location whose item goes to another player never echoes back, so the shop showed it as never bought and charged you for it again every time you reopened the mechlab. Shop state is now derived from the server's `checked_locations` instead, which reflects every location *we've* checked regardless of who receives the item - As part of the same fix, shop/training state now also picks up: locations found while disconnected (synced on the next connect), server-side auto-releases (e.g. another game completing and releasing all its remaining checks), and checks made by another client connected to the same slot in co-op - Fixed the shop being able to skip past a still-unbought level if a later level in the same stat got checked out of order (same-slot co-op, a release) — it now keeps offering the actual next unbought level, and instantly recognizes the skipped one as owned once you reach it - Fixed the shop/training price label staying one step behind after a purchase until you moved focus away and back — it now updates immediately ---
### Links
- [Setup guide](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf-apworld/blob/master/worlds/openomf/docs/setup_en.md) - [Game guide](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf-apworld/blob/master/worlds/openomf/docs/en_One%20Must%20Fall%202097.md) - [Parent repo](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf) - [Client repo](https://github.com/stubobis1/openomf) - [AP world repo](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf-apworld) - [Issues](https://github.com/stubobis1/archipelago-openomf/issues)

# CTR Archipelago 0.2.0 Alpha 4
Alpha 4 combines the current correction build with the upstream native renderer and retail-parity sync so the full candidate can be tested together. This is a prerelease, not stable 0.2.0.
The client and `ctr.apworld` are a matched pair. Install the apworld included in your platform archive before generating a seed, and keep every player in the room on Alpha 4.
## Included in this candidate
- The full Alpha 3 feature set and apworld logic. - The current upstream renderer, retail-parity, audio, UI, vehicle and profile port. - The confirmed zero-Key Ripper Roo boss-return fix. - Configurable sustained-trap duration from 10 to 90 seconds or Full race, with 15 seconds as the default. - Transition and podium diagnostics, with repeated podium diagnostic lines suppressed until reconnect.
## Testing status
The focused transition, podium, diagnostic-dedup, first-Key and trap-scheduler harnesses pass. Fresh 32-bit AP, vanilla and Windows builds also pass. The combined upstream-port candidate still needs its Steam runtime gate, so please treat rendering, pause behavior, profile save/load and race transitions as active test areas.
The racer-ownership reload repair is not included in these bytes. Back up late saves and report any unreceived racer that becomes playable after loading a profile.
See `README-ALPHA4.md` and `KNOWN-ISSUES.md` inside the archive for hashes, setup notes and the current attention list. CTR-AP does not ship Crash Team Racing game data.

entry.title: Crypt of the NecroDancer v0.8.0
entry.content:
### Notes - **This update requires AP Redux mod v4.0.0 or newer**. The apworld and the mod changed significantly this release, and older mod versions will refuse to connect. The same applies in reverse - **In-progress multiworlds cannot be carried over to v0.8.0**. This update adds a variety of new locations types and reshapes the item pool. Finish your existing worlds before updating.
### Changes - Refactored practically the entire APWorld logic (generation, items, locations, regions) to abide by recommendations provided by the community, APQuest's implementation specifically. - I'm 99% certain generation is working as intended, but please reach out if something seems out of order! - Add option to include shrines as checks. - Enabling this adds all available shrines to the item pool depending on enabled DLC. A shrine that has not been acquired yet will not generate mid-run. Upon first activation of the shrine, the check will be sent to the client. A shrine no character in your pool could ever trigger will not be included (Aria cannot access Shrine of Pain, for instance). - Add option to set how many items found mid-run will be considered as checks per zone. Default is 8, but can be increased to 25. - Item generation chance (default 25%) makes a 25% chance for items generated on level load to instead be these per-zone item checks. Items can be found spawned in secret rooms, (non-flawless) chests, crates, barrels, and shops currently. - Add option to include flawless boss chests as checks per zone. - Add option to set how many rows of AP Lobby shop locations will generate in the multiworld. Default is 4, but can be increased to 25. - Setting this value to -1 (or "auto") will leave the shop rows as-is: 8 rows without DLC enabled, 12 rows with all DLC enabled. - Add option to set how many progress locations exist per zone. Default is 2 (Floor 2 + Zone completion), but can be increased to 4 (Floors 1, 2, 3, and Zone completion). - Personally, I'm a bit on the fence regarding this change; you're still required to go through the whole zone for all checks, so it feels like there's little benefit for this change aside from reducing location amounts in the multiworld. Considering changing this to not always include the Zone completion, which should alleviate having to play through the entirety of each zone as each character in the pool. - Add option to set speedrun time limits for getting All Zones location checks. Configurable for each character, default is 0 (disabled), but can be increased to 60 minutes per character. - Any values set less than 3 minutes are increased to 3 minutes minimum. - Add diamond exchange rate option to determine how many diamonds are received on successful run completion. Default is 100 gold per diamond, but can be either reduced to 0 (disabled) or 1000. - Add option to handle DeathLinks when playing multiplayer: does each player dying send a DeathLink packet or only when all players die? Default is the latter. - Add +1 Red/Black/Purple Chest Per Zone and Progressive Gold Multiplier items. - Add 12 new filler items to the item pool: "Bomb", "3 Bombs", "Grenade", "Spare Potion", "Spare Coupon", "Spare Heart Transplant", "Answered Need", "Depth Skip", "Random Item", "Random Shrine", "Charmed Escort", "Fire Sale" - Spare items spawn that item for the player but does not unlock it for generation mid-run. Answered Need and Depth Skip spawn a Scroll of Need and a Depth Scroll respectively. - Random Item spawns any chest pool item, regardless of unlock. Random Shrine spawns any acquired shrine around the player. - Charmed Escort spawns 3 random charmed enemies around the player(s). These can be minibosses and shopkeepers. - Fire Sale makes all shops on the current floor 50% off. - Add 4 new traps to the item pool: - Frank Trap (Amplified Required): Frankensteinway spawns in the level, similarly to Dead Ringer Trap - Freddy Trap: Summons a passive Shopkeeper around each player - Wall Pig Trap: Replaces tiles with a vacant left or right tile throughout the level 7% of the time with a Wall Pig facing in that respective direction. A minimum of 5 Wall Pigs will spawn regardless. - Trap Trap: Replaces vacant floor tiles throughout the level at a 10% chance with traps, more weighted towards spike and confusion traps. - Adjusted starting inventory logic to always give items related to disabled settings (Materials, Progressive Access Keys, Character Room Key, Shrines) - Modified location growth to be interchangeable between per zone item checks (if greater than 0) and shop item checks (if greater than 0). If locations are still needed, then shop rows will grow regardless of their setting. - Supply item room item categories and associated items over to the mod from the client. - Fix character item requirements being tracked separately by the apworld and the mod. The client now supplies the mod all of the character item requirements.
Please see the [setup file](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/blob/crypt-of-the-necrodancer/worlds/cotnd/docs/setup_en.md) for getting started.
Please inform me of any issues through the associated [Crypt of the NecroDancer channel in the Archipelago Discord](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1192775219740422176) or through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/lastingParadox/Archipelago-CotND/issues).

entry.title: Cursed Words v0.5.0
entry.content:
## Information This archipelago implementation is in **early development** and is in public pre-release for testing, so may not be complete and/or may contain bugs that heavily disrupt the experience. It is not advised to include this in large multiworlds at this time, so only do so at your own risk and inform your host beforehand.
## Setup Guide Please visit the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/JammyGeeza/CursedWords-Archipelago#setup-guide) for instructions on how to install the mod client.
## Issue / Bug Reporting If you experience issues that are not already on the [known issues list](https://github.com/JammyGeeza/CursedWords-Archipelago/issues/views/12865), please raise a new issue or post in the [Cursed Words Forum in the Archipelago Discord Server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1499176806962692196)
## Release Notes This release provides the following updates: ### APWorld ### Updates - Re-worked Sticker / Stamp requirements for Character Stage access rules - Characters require a 5-Sticker and 5-Stamp Synergy with are treated as `progression` and are guaranteed in the item pool - Players can customise the synergies with YAML options which overrides the preset synergies - Access rules require XX% of both Stickers and Stamps Synergies for stage progression - `guaranteed_stickers` and `guaranteed_stamps` removed as a consequence of this new functionality - Added locations for `Clear Boss / Encounter with X Grids Unused` - Added `Pinsanity` locations and YAML option - Added two Trap items `Force Grid Re-roll` and `Lose Money` with Trap Percentage and Weighting YAML options - Added Filler Weighting YAML options - Added YAML option to set maximum `Money Earned` locations - Added YAML option to set maximum `Word Length` locations - Added YAML option to set maximum `Word Score` locations - General location name re-wordings for better grouping and clarity - General YAML option description re-wordings for better clarity - Reduced starting 'common' Stickers / Stamps from 12 to 10 ### Fixes - Fixed options template generation issue - Updated `Shopsanity` access rule logic to no longer be gated by Stage 2 ### Client ### Updates - Updated Location / Item mappings to support additions and changes in the APWorld - Save Slots in the menu now display the last known Slot Name and Locations Completed count ### Fixes - Fixes an issue causing `Buy a Consumable Tile` location not checking - Fixes an issue causing some `Tilesanity` checks to be unreachable - Fixes an issue causing restocking the shop to be very slow when `Shopsanity` is enabled

# Drehmal Archipelago v0.3.0
## Bugfixes: - Made tower unlock rewards thread safe - Now batch sends location check packets to Archipelago server - Implemented a more reliable fix for advancement rewards glitch - Prevented teleport trap's effect from sending players out of bounds - Fixed various typos - Fixed Aphelion deathlooping
## Improvements: - Added randomized starting location - Two new completion goals: - Added completion goal for reaching Drehmal's end credits room - Added completion goal for reaching a certain Terminus unlock percentage - Added music randomizer option for Drehmal's custom soundtrack - Logic overhaul for vanilla and vanilla-like advancements - Moved Foundry to the Veldt for balancing purposes - Buffed the teleport trap substantially
## Setup:
### Required software:
- [Drehmal APOTHEOSIS v2.2.2f for Minecraft Fabric 1.20.1](https://www.drehmal.net/downloads) - Additional mods: - Drehmal Archipelago Mod v0.3.0 - [Koala Lib v1.2.14](https://modrinth.com/mod/koala_lib/version/1.2.14) - [Unsafe World Random Access Detector v1.1.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/uwrad/version/1.1.0) - The hi_drehmal_rando datapack v0.3.0
### Joining a Multiworld
1. Install Drehmal v2.2.2f and its corresponding modpack (Note that Drehmal provides a custom installer, available on its downloads page, if you don't want to manually create the Fabric installation) 2. Add the three additional mods listed above to the mods folder of Drehmal's Minecraft installation 3. Go into the save file you're going to be playing on and replace the hi_drehmal.zip datapack with the hi_drehmal_rando.zip datapack at path [Fabric install]/saves/Drehmal APOTHEOSIS 2.2.2f/datapacks/hi_drehmal_rando.zip 4. Launch Minecraft and enter the Drehmal world 5. In the lobby room, before activating the first terminal, run the command /archipelago connect "[server name]:[port]" [player name] 6. Have fun!
### Rejoining an earlier game
On reconnect, if your connection info hasn't changed, the mod should automatically reconnect you to the Archipelago server. Otherwise, run /archipelago disconnect and then run the connect command again with the new information.

entry.title: Mega Man Zero 3 v0.3.3
entry.content:
Weapons are now progressive upgrades, minibosses are location checks, and graphical polish for everything implemented has been done. This is probably the last feature update for a while. The next big addition will be enemy randomization. [Check out the full readme before playing.](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago) # Features - Minibosses are now location checks. This was just needed to have more location checks for the new progressive weapon items. ## Weapon Progression The four weapons are now progressive items, similar to the weapon XP system in Zero 1 and 2. The pool holds several copies of "Progressive Buster", "Progressive Z-Saber" and so on, and each copy you receive moves that weapon one step up its path. | Weapon | Progressive Upgrades | | --- | --- | | Buster | weapon, semi charge, full charge, damage (+1, +2, +3) | | Z-Saber | weapon, 2nd slash, 3rd slash, charged slash, damage (+1, +2, +3) | | Recoil Rod | weapon, charged rod, damage (+1, +2, +3) | | Shield Boomerang | weapon, charged throw, damage (+1, +2, +3) | The first copy gives you the weapon itself, the ones after it unlock that weapon's abilities, and the last three are attack power boosts (ripped from the E-Reader cards). The upgrade progress is shown in game as stars in the pause menu like in Zero 1 and 2. Randomize_weapons has been removed as an option. You can still give yourself each weapon to start with using the `starting_weapons` option. `starting_weapons: ['Buster', 'Z-Saber'. 'Recoil Rod', 'Shield Boomerang]` ## Graphical Changes - Items from Archipelago now show their own icon in the popup over Zero's head. The table is seen below. Each piece of art had to be downscaled and had their color palettes merged to share one 15 color sheet. If you are a pixel artist and want to do a better job, please feel free to do so, I'm not great at this.

- The mission select screen was also graphically updated and given much more polish. - The stage select art being lifted from the dialogue portraits for Omega, Crea, Prea, and Weil. - Locked stages now show up with the TV static animation from the vanilla game. # Bug Fixes - The animation around unchecked 1-UPs was corrected to not use the same palette slot as Zero's dash afterimage. - Secret Disk 066 now requires mobility in logic. Fun fact: its the only collectable where having the frog chip actually matters. # Known bugs - There have been repeated issues of trackers reporting currently unobtainable items as obtainable. Most errors should be fixed now. - The item popup only shows one at a time, skipping multiple if they arrive at the same time. This might get fixed later. I hope to soon bring this world from unstable to stable, so report anything that seems off, not just bugs!

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.5.1
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.5.1
A maintenance release: one generation failure fixed, and a round of corrections to the logic that decides when a check is reachable.
### Fixed
**Generation failed with BlazeandCave's Advancements Pack and `challenge_sanity: all`.** Any seed combining those two options crashed during generation and produced no output. The cause was a loop in the logic for BACAP's "Super Challenges" tab. These seeds now generate normally. Other `challenge_sanity` settings were never affected.
### Improved
**Sixteen checks no longer come for free.** Each of them could previously be completed without owning anything the randomizer had placed, which let progression open up earlier than intended. They now ask for what the game actually requires — among them:
- items that can only be collected with **shears** or **Silk Touch**, such as glow lichen, dead bushes, grass, ferns, vines and mushroom blocks - **nether wart**, which only grows inside Nether Fortresses and Bastion Remnants, and previously opened the entire brewing tree on arrival in the Nether - **wither roses**, which require defeating the Wither - **string** from cobwebs, and **carved pumpkins**
Tool requirements are now read directly from the game files, so they stay correct as Minecraft changes.
### Upgrading
- The mod and the apworld are released together and should be used as a matched set. - Seeds generated with v0.5.0 are unaffected and can be finished as they are. - Because the logic is stricter, regenerating an existing v0.5.0 seed with v0.5.1 will produce a different placement. Generate a new seed rather than expecting the old one to be reproduced. - No YAML changes are required.

entry.title: Team Fortress 2 Mann vs Machine v1.10.0
entry.content: ## Changes Most of this release is what the 1.9.0 play-tests found. ### The run - Items and locations print by name in chat. They arrived as bare numbers: the bridge never asked the multiworld for the names. - The mission list says what you cleared. Another world running `!collect` on its goal marks every check it still holds. Those missions then read as cleared here, though nobody on this server played them. Yours now read "cleared", the room's read "collected". - A sentry buster blowing itself up is no longer the giant kill. It carries the giant flag, so it took the mission's giant check with it and the real giant that died later reported nothing. - Cash Bundles pay the bots as well as the players, and a bot that rejoins keeps what its bundles paid for. ### Getting a server up - The connect address is on the Session tab of the terminal interface, as the full `connect` command rather than a bare address. It was only reachable by pressing C on the log tab. - Joining from the launcher aims at the address your machine actually answers on. Docker, WSL and virtual machines each leave one behind, and the link took whichever came first. That gives "connection failed after 4 retries" and a stall at two bars. The LAN tab of the server browser finds the same server first try. - Settings changed in the terminal interface reach the server. `server.cfg` was written once when the launcher started and never again. The launcher saved a class you unticked mid-session, showed it unticked, and played it anyway. - The launcher says whether Steam's item server answered. Without it everybody plays full stock and nothing said why, which is indistinguishable from a setup step you missed. - The Docker quick start downloads a file that exists. The documented URL returned 404 on every release, and `curl` fails silently, so you got no `.env` and hit a missing password several steps later. - A crash reads as a crash. The launcher reported one as "bridge stopping", which is its own shutdown message, so the component that had not failed was the one people reported. ### The bots - RED holds its size. One request for six bots added nine at mission load, and they stayed until somebody restarted a wave. A surplus now goes within three seconds. A player who reconnects mid-mission gets their seat back instead of spectator. - A class you untick is never drawn. A lineup that named some seats left the rest to the mod, blacklist and all, and an unticked Spy walked onto RED. - One build press makes one building. The engineer asked whether he had succeeded in the same frame as he pressed, and the game answers on the next one. So he pressed again, and two dispensers stood under one engineer. Four waves of the test bed counted eighteen of those before, and none after. - Engineers stop buying the disposable mini sentry. Measured over six waves of Decoy: defender deaths per wave ran 0 to 10 without it and 11 to 17 with it, and sentries lost doubled. It is a switch, `sm_redbots_feature_engineer_disposable`, if you want it back. - Teleporter exits go outside the blast that kills the sentry. The engineer put one 150 units from the nest, and a sentry buster reaches 400. One buster took the sentry and the team's forward spawn together. - Decoy has its sniper spots back. A test removed them and every build since carried the gap. - A bot at the upgrade station follows your ready. It had no readiness of its own while shopping, so it never pressed F4 and the wave waited on it. A bot mid-taunt readies too. - Raising the RED team size says what the game allows. Asking for twelve silently produced no bots at all, which left fewer than asking for six. ### Under it - Native Linux servers keep the engine watchdog off. It kills the server when a frame takes too long, which fires under load a machine survives otherwise. - Debug bundles open with what looks wrong: crashes, plugin exceptions, stuck bots, and the lines a run repeated most. They also say whether `server.cfg` still matches the settings beside it, and where to look when a crash left no dump. - The bots mod is on v2.17.1. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`.env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/.env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NWU4MzZhYzViM2M1MGRhOGQ2NTAzOWMwYjI5ZTQ0OTU6MTc4Nzc3ODU4Ng==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NzVjNjYzMzRlMmEzODhjNjg2ZjJiYTJiMzAzZDE5YWI6MTc4Nzc3ODU5MQ==/detection)

entry.title: Spyro: A Hero's Tail v2.1.0
entry.content:
# v2.1.0: Various Misc. Things (Prerelease) *Intended for use with game mod version 14 (see attachments).*
**This update is being posted as a prerelease, hopefully to be posted as a full release this coming weekend after people have a chance to do some test seeds. It has been internally tested to the best of my abilities and should be stable enough to not have major concerns. If you would prefer to play the latest non-prerelease update, you can find that [here](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/releases/tag/AHT-v2.0.2).**
2 small parts of v2.1.0 were included in the v2.0.1 hotfix (death link amnesty and the new game mod versioning system). This release contains those, as well as the following additional things: - Fixed a missing glide requirement in Dragonfly Falls. - Added `automatic` setting to `boss_lair_forcing` which forces all goal bosses (if any are part of goal) to have collectively the highest cost(s). - Expanded location groups to include per-level and per-realm groups for Dark Gems, Dragon Eggs, Light Gems, Fireworks, and Locked Chests. Some other misc. groups added as well (such as "Starter Checks"). - Tweaked `movement_randomization` to allow for individual toggling of each ability, instead of it being all or nothing. - Renamed `starting_breath` -> `starting_breaths` and redesigned it to allow for starting with multiple breaths, none, or a random one if list is empty. - `starting_realms` was made to match the above behavior i.e. random starting breath if list is empty. Neither requires `auto_corrections` to be set to `fix`. - "Generics" filler item selection process improved to be more uniform. Each will be picked once each before doubling any up, and same for tripling, quadrupling, etc.
[Setup Guide](https://github.com/PhoenixAki/PhoenixAP/wiki/Spyro:-AHT-1-%E2%80%90-Setup-Guide-&-FAQ)
